items.title: Meraki Developers lines up Celeste as its Dubai South debut
items.summary: Meraki plans to officially unveil Celeste in November 2026 as part of a seven-project Dubai South pipeline; unit mix, prices and handover are still to be announced.

items.title: Dubai Holding hires CSCEC ME to build Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers
items.summary: An AED 5bn contract covers Dubai Holding's new headquarters plus two towers with 754 Jumeirah-branded residences; handover of the residences is scheduled for 2030.
